subject: Pipeline lock preflight: provisional capacity check for Nexis Labs
messages:
From: Avery Shaw <avery.shaw@nexislabs.com>
To: irene_choi@redwood.ai
Cc: ops@nexislabs.com
Date: 2026-12-14T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Request: provisional capacity standby for production pilot

Hi Irene,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the Nexis team is enthusiastic about Redwood Dedicated. We have a pilot ramp scheduled second week of February and legal is asking for a very small, provisional standby commitment so we can align procurement and timelines.

Can Redwood put a 30‑day soft hold on ~8 A100-equivalent slots in us-west-2 for the 2/8-3/10 window? This would be a conditional hold: we need a quick internal availability check and a short note that resources can be reserved pending contract.

I attached a short MOA (nexis_moa_draft.pdf) with the proposed window and signoff conditions — happy to iterate.

Appreciate a quick sanity check (time is tight).

Best,
Avery Shaw
Head of Infrastructure
Nexis Labs
From: irene_choi@redwood.ai
To: Avery Shaw <avery.shaw@nexislabs.com>, ops@nexislabs.com
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-12-14T10:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: provisional capacity standby for production pilot

Avery — thanks for the MOA and clear window. I can do the internal check and propose a minimal pre-commit note that sales/legal can attach to the MOA. 

Ben: can you run a quick availability scan for us-west-2 for the 8 A100-equivalent slots from 2027-02-08 through 2027-03-10 (flexible +/- 3 days) and confirm whether we can offer a 30-day soft hold? If we need to suggest compatible model/quantization profiles to reduce raw slot count please flag that.

Jordan: if we can hold, I'll need the exact wording for a provisional hold statement to Legal (one paragraph) and a short ops runbook (what triggers true allocation).

Avery: we'll aim to get a firm internal answer within 48 hours and provide a short hold note you can attach.

—Irene
Irene Choi
Head of Sales Ops, Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: irene_choi@redwood.ai
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>, Avery Shaw <avery.shaw@nexislabs.com>
Date: 2026-12-14T13:30:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: provisional capacity standby for production pilot

Irene / team — ran the inventory and pushed a snapshot to the shared Drive (capacity_snapshot_20261214.csv). Summary:

- Raw availability (us-west-2) for 2027-02-08 to 2027-03-10: at the moment we have 12 A100-equivalent slots unallocated across Dedicated pools (after existing commitments).
- Node affinity constraints: 3 of those slots are in pools tied to customers with strict thermal affinity; we should avoid overlapping maintenance windows.
- Short-term reserve impact: a 30-day soft hold on 8 slots would reduce flexible pool headroom to 4 slots. This is doable but increases risk for same-week ad hoc spikes.

Recommendations:
1) Offer Nexis a 30-day soft hold for 8 slots with the following conditions: the hold is non-binding until contract signature; we provide a 72-hour firm allocation notice once the PO is received; Redwood reserves the right to relocate to a compatible pod (same GPU-equivalent) with >=95% performance parity if the original nodes undergo emergent maintenance.
2) To reduce slot count, suggest a mixed profile: 6 A100-equivalent + 2 quantized T4-equivalent for non-latency-critical batch tasks in the pilot. That keeps end-to-end cost down and eases runbook constraints.

I'll attach the CSV to this thread and mark maintenance blackout dates to avoid. If legal wants tighter wording send it my way.

-Ben
Ben Carter
Head of Capacity Planning, Redwood Inference
From: irene_choi@redwood.ai
To: Avery Shaw <avery.shaw@nexislabs.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-12-16T15:02:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: provisional capacity standby for production pilot

Avery — quick update and proposed provisional-hold wording below. Ben confirmed a feasible 30-day soft hold on 8 A100-equivalent slots with the mixed-profile option to reduce risk. I uploaded the inventory snapshot and a short ops note to the Drive link.

Proposed provisional hold paragraph (for Legal / MOA):
"Redwood Inference confirms the ability to place a non-binding, provisional 30-day hold on eight (8) GPU-equivalent slots in the us-west-2 region for the period ~2027-02-08 to ~2027-03-10, subject to contract signature and receipt of a purchase order. The hold is conditional: Redwood will provide firm allocation within 72 hours of PO receipt, and may relocate resources to a compatible pod in the event of emergent maintenance with performance parity maintained. The hold does not create a binding inventory commitment and may be released by mutual agreement."

Next steps:
- If that wording looks acceptable, confirm and we will attach it to the MOA and create a HubSpot task (DEAL-783920) to track the signature timeline.
- Ben / Ops will mark the slots as a soft hold in our internal roster and flag the affected pools for blackout.

Avery — ping if you want edits; otherwise I'll submit to Legal and Sales tonight.

Thanks,
—Irene
Irene Choi
Head of Sales Ops, Redwood Inference
